soundscape.en: Steady rain taps against roof tiles and stone while distant water laps against the canal bank.
Wind moves through bamboo stalks with dry leaf rustle and occasional bird calls.
Layers of distant vendor calls, footstep scuffs on stone, and the clink of ceramic bowls.
Low room ambience with the soft creak of floorboards and fabric movement.
Gentle water lapping, faint mist drip, and sparse morning birdsong.
Near silence broken only by the crunch of snow underfoot and cold wind.
Continuous cricket chirps with a low night ambience and occasional distant dog bark.
Passing traffic hum, distant horns, and footsteps on wet pavement.
Espresso machine hiss, cup clinks, and muffled conversation around the room.
A steady metallic wheel rhythm beneath a low ventilation hum.
Fire crackles with popping embers and the soft shift of burning wood.
Waves break against the rocks with spray hiss and receding gravel.
Distant echoes of impact, settling dust, and heavy breathing.

music.en: Sparse guzheng arpeggios at a slow tempo with a sustained low drone underneath.
A solo erhu line at a slow tempo, joined by soft plucked strings in the middle.
A breathy bamboo flute melody at a slow tempo over airy sustained pads.
Sparse piano notes at a slow tempo with long sustain and a gentle fade.
Sustained cello notes at a slow tempo, gradually decreasing in volume.
Low sustained strings rising slowly in volume, joined by high sustained violins.
A steady low drum pulse at a moderate tempo, accelerating slightly toward the end.
A low electronic pulse at a slow tempo with filtered synth sweeps.
Wide sustained synth pads at a slow tempo with a slow filter opening.
A soft acoustic-guitar pattern at a moderate tempo with upright-bass notes.
Warm folk instrumentation at a moderate tempo with light percussion.
Full orchestral swells at a moderate tempo with brass accents and a final sustained chord.
